{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv("/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv")

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers, excluding QA orders
df_loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
                        (df['status'] == 'completed') & 
                        (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Verify the number of QA orders removed
qa_count = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99].shape[0]

# Print results
mean_revenue, qa_count, df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].describe()"}
